steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Dance appreciation is the ability to analyse, describe and evaluate dance works using informed judgement | Key Fact: The AO4 framework is the AQA assessment objective for appreciation: analyse and evaluate dance | Key Fact: Analysis means breaking down a dance into its component parts to understand how it works | Key Fact: Description involves identifying and clearly stating what you see in a dance performance

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from dance appreciation skills, and one past-paper question.
